seeds.claim: Use repository records before recalled memory when resolving workflow authority.
Nested workflow stages inherit the outer memory session and do not recall again.
Keep implementation worker prompts grounded in planning issues and repository evidence.
Teaching missions remain authoritative for demonstrated learning and review state.
Prefer concise progress updates while implementation is underway.
Flush workflow memory only after normal completion.
Flush the outer workflow session at completion, pause, stop, or handoff.
